location.en: Sunset Point, a viewpoint above Port Aurora harbor
location.zh: 夕陽岬，可以俯瞰極光港的觀景台

goal.en: Ask a stranger to take a group photo, explain the phone and get one more shot.
goal.zh: 請陌生人幫你們拍合照，教對方怎麼按，再請他多拍一張。

background: hilltop viewpoint with a wooden railing, wide view of a harbor town and sea at sunset, orange and pink sky, wildflowers, a bench, gentle golden light

intro.en: That evening, the rain stops. You climb up to Sunset Point to watch the sun go down over the harbor.
intro.zh: 那天傍晚雨停了。你們爬上夕陽岬，看太陽在港口上方落下。

intro.en: We need a photo of all three of us. Kai, ask someone!
intro.zh: 我們需要一張三個人的合照。凱，去找人幫忙！

intro.en: An older man with a big camera is standing nearby.
intro.zh: 旁邊站著一位掛著大相機的年長男士。

lines.en: What a sunset, huh? Best view in Port Aurora.
lines.zh: 夕陽真美，對吧？極光港最棒的景色。

choices.en: It's beautiful. Would you mind taking a photo of us?
choices.zh: 真的很美。可以麻煩你幫我們拍張照嗎？
choices.tip: Would you mind + V-ing...? 是請陌生人幫忙時最客氣的句型。

choices.en: It's beautiful. Would you mind to take a photo for us?
choices.zh: 真的很美。你介意幫我們拍張照嗎？

lines.en: Would I mind...? Oh, you want to photograph me? Sure!
lines.zh: 我介不介意……？喔，你想拍我嗎？好啊！

story.en: Walter strikes a proud pose in front of the sunset. You now have a lovely photo of a stranger and none of your friends.
story.zh: 華特在夕陽前擺出驕傲的姿勢。你現在有一張陌生人的美照，卻沒有一張朋友的合照。

fail.why: mind 後面要接 V-ing，不能接 to V：Would you mind taking a photo of us?。「幫我們拍」用 of us，不用 for us。

choices.en: Excuse me, could you take us a photo?
choices.zh: 不好意思，可以幫我們拍一張照嗎？

lines.en: Take you to a photo? You mean a photo shop? There's one down the hill.
lines.zh: 帶你們去照片？你是說相片行嗎？山下有一家。

story.en: Walter kindly draws you a map to the nearest photo shop. It closes in ten minutes, and the sun is almost gone.
story.zh: 華特好心地畫地圖告訴你最近的相片行。它十分鐘後打烊，太陽也快下山了。

fail.why: 「幫我們拍照」直譯成 take us a photo，take us 會被聽成「帶我們去」。要說 Could you take a photo of us?

lines.en: Not at all! I'd be glad to.

choices.en: Thank you so much! Here's my phone.
choices.zh: 太感謝了！這是我的手機。
choices.tip: Would you mind...? 的回答 Not at all 代表「樂意幫忙」，直接道謝交出手機。

choices.en: Oh, okay. Sorry to bother you, then.

lines.en: Wait, I said I'd do it! Hello? Come back!
lines.zh: 等等，我說我願意啊！喂？回來啊！

title.en: Not at All, Not a Photo

story.en: You walk away sadly before Walter can explain. The sun sets without your group photo.
story.zh: 華特還來不及解釋，你就失落地走開了。太陽下山了，合照沒拍成。

fail.why: Would you mind...? 問的是「你介意嗎」，所以 Not at all（一點也不介意）其實是答應。聽到這句就說 Thank you so much!

choices.en: Great. Make sure you don't cut off our heads.
choices.zh: 太好了。你可別把我們的頭切掉喔。

lines.en: I've been taking photos for forty years, you know.
lines.zh: 我拍照已經拍了四十年了，你知道嗎。

story.en: The photo is perfect, with every head included. Walter's mood, however, is not.
story.zh: 照片拍得很完美，每個人的頭都在。不過華特的心情就沒那麼完美了。

fail.why: 請陌生人幫忙還先叮嚀「別拍壞」，聽起來像不信任對方。先道謝再交手機：Thank you so much! Here's my phone.。

lines.en: Now, how does this thing work?

choices.tip: Just press this button. 用簡單的祈使句說明，Just 讓語氣更輕鬆。

choices.en: You just pressing this button, very easy.
choices.zh: 你就按這個按鈕，很簡單。

lines.en: I'm pressing it? I haven't touched anything yet!
lines.zh: 我正在按？我什麼都還沒碰啊！

story.en: Walter gets confused and taps the screen everywhere. You end up with a ten-second video of his thumb.
story.zh: 華特一頭霧水，在螢幕上到處亂點。你得到一段十秒鐘的大拇指影片。

fail.why: 教別人怎麼做要用原形動詞開頭的祈使句：Just press this button.。pressing 前面少了 be 動詞，意思也變成「正在按」。

choices.en: It's easy. Even my grandma can use it.
choices.zh: 很簡單啦，連我阿嬤都會用。

lines.en: Your grandma, huh? I was using cameras before you were born.
lines.zh: 你阿嬤喔？我玩相機的時候你都還沒出生呢。

story.en: Walter takes the photo with a slightly hurt look. You get a great shot of three people looking guilty.
story.zh: 華特帶著有點受傷的表情按下快門。你們得到一張三個人一臉心虛的好照片。

fail.why: 「連我阿嬤都會」在中文是說很簡單，但對年長的人說，聽起來像在暗示對方老了。直接說 Just press this button. 就好。

lines.en: Here you go! How does that look?
Oh no, my eyes are closed!

choices.en: Thanks! Sorry, could you take one more?
choices.zh: 謝謝！不好意思，可以再拍一張嗎？
choices.tip: 請人再拍一張說 Could you take one more?，先說 Sorry 更客氣。

choices.en: Thanks. Okay, now twenty more from different angles.
choices.zh: 謝謝。好，現在換不同角度再拍二十張。

lines.en: Twenty? I'm on vacation too, you know.
lines.zh: 二十張？我也是來度假的耶。

story.en: Walter hands back your phone and goes to enjoy the sunset. Leo's closed-eye photo becomes the official trip photo.
story.zh: 華特把手機還你，自己去看夕陽了。里歐閉眼的那張，成了這趟旅行的官方合照。

fail.why: 請陌生人幫忙拍照，一兩張就好，要求太多會占用對方的時間。有人閉眼時，說 Sorry, could you take one more? 剛剛好。

lines.en: Again... one what? The sunset again? Come back tomorrow, same time!
lines.zh: 再……一個什麼？再看一次夕陽？明天同一時間再來吧！

story.en: Walter tells you the best time to see tomorrow's sunset, then waves goodbye. Leo's eyes stay closed forever.
story.zh: 華特告訴你明天看夕陽的最佳時間，揮手道別。照片裡的里歐永遠閉著眼。

fail.why: 「再一張」直譯成 Again one 不是英文。要說 One more, please. 或 Could you take one more?

lines.en: Got it! Eyes open this time, everyone.
lines.zh: 拍到了！這次大家都睜著眼睛。

lines.en: Perfect. This one's going on my wall.
lines.zh: 完美。這張我要掛在牆上。

lines.en: Thank you so much! Enjoy the rest of your trip.
lines.zh: 太感謝你了！祝你接下來旅途愉快。

story.en: The sun dips into the sea just as Walter takes the shot. Three friends, one harbor, zero closed eyes.
story.zh: 華特按下快門的那一刻，太陽剛好沉進海裡。三個朋友、一座港口，沒有人閉眼。

notes.en: Would you mind taking a photo of us?
notes.zh: 可以麻煩你幫我們拍張照嗎？
notes.explain: Would you mind 後面接 V-ing。「幫我們拍照」是 take a photo of us，不要說 take us a photo（會變成「帶我們去」）。

example.en: Would you mind watching my bag for a minute?
example.zh: 可以麻煩你幫我看一下包包嗎？

notes.zh: 一點也不介意（樂意幫忙）。
notes.explain: Would you mind...? 問的是「你介意嗎」，所以回答 Not at all 代表願意。聽到這句不要以為被拒絕了。

example.en: Would you mind closing the window? / Not at all.
example.zh: 可以麻煩你關窗嗎？／當然可以。

notes.explain: 教別人用手機或機器時，用原形動詞開頭的祈使句最清楚。加 Just 讓語氣輕鬆，表示很簡單。

example.en: Just tap the screen to focus, then press here.
example.zh: 點一下螢幕對焦，再按這裡就好。

notes.explain: 「再一張」是 one more，不是 again one。更客氣的說法是 Sorry, could you take one more?

example.en: Sorry, could you take one more? Someone blinked.
example.zh: 不好意思，可以再拍一張嗎？有人眨眼了。

notes.explain: 請陌生人拍照，一兩張就好，結束時好好道謝。也避免評論對方的年紀，「連我阿嬤都會」這類話對年長者很失禮。

example.en: Thank you so much. You really saved our trip photo!
example.zh: 太感謝了，你真的拯救了我們的旅行合照！
